newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY LENDS LEBANON $60 MLN, GRANTS IT $7 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ITALY LENDS LEBANON $60 MLN, GRANTS IT $7 MLN.

text.p: Italy signed on Friday an agreement with the Lebanese government to lend it $60 million and grant it $7 million to finance infrastructure and developmental projects.
The loan, which carries 0.5 percent annual interest rate, has a duration of 35 years including a 14-year grace period. It will be used in sewage, water and electricity projects.

The Lebanese government's reconstruction agency, the Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) said in a statement that the agreement was signed by the Italian ambassador in Beirut Carlo Calia and the head of the CDR Nabil al-Jisr.
The agreement also included a grant of $7 million for health and rural development projects, the CDR said.
